visual_action: A montage of clips showcasing President Joe Biden and his administration. The video opens with a smiling Joe Biden at a podium. It then cuts to Kamala Harris being sworn in, followed by Joe Biden receiving a vaccination. Subsequent clips show Biden signing documents at his desk and at a public ceremony surrounded by people. The video concludes with Biden shaking hands with Ketanji Brown Jackson outside the White House.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is the subject of the entire video, featured in multiple clips and named in the opening on-screen text as having 'kept to his promises'.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Shown being sworn in, with the on-screen text 'First woman to serve as Vice President'.

cast.name: Ketanji Brown Jackson
cast.evidence: Shown shaking hands with Joe Biden, accompanying the on-screen text 'Selected the first Black woman to be confirmed to the Supreme Court'.

cast.name: Thomas R Carper
cast.evidence: Visible in the background crowd during the clip where Biden signs the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act.

on_screen_text.text: 3 years ago today, Biden announced his run for presidency...
Since then, he's kept to his promises
✅ First woman to serve as Vice President
✅ Ensured Americans had access to COVID vaccines
✅ Signed the American Rescue Plan into law
✅ Signed the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act into law
✅ Selected the first Black woman to be confirmed to the Supreme Court

spoken_summary: There is no speech or dialogue in the video; only instrumental music plays.
audio_music: A gentle and inspirational piano score plays consistently throughout the video, creating a reflective and positive tone.
editing_pacing: The video is a slow-paced montage consisting of a series of clips with cross-fades, each accompanied by a text overlay describing an accomplishment.
central_claim: Joe Biden has successfully fulfilled his promises since announcing his run for president, as demonstrated by a list of key accomplishments.
intended_effect: To make the viewer feel proud of the Biden administration's record and to reinforce the idea that he is a president who keeps his promises.
